digits: Generate a production transparent-background sprite atlas of TEN ARABIC DIGITS made of pixel-art fire, matching the reference ember's crisp large pixel clusters, cream-yellow hot center, orange midtones and red edges. Exact regular 5 columns by 2 rows equal cells. Top row left to right 0 1 2 3 4. Bottom row left to right 5 6 7 8 9. One numeral per cell, ALL TEN required exactly once. Clearly legible bold upright numeral silhouettes, clean counters in 0 6 8 9. Each character itself is made of flame, with short flickering upward flame tips. Consistent baseline, SAME numeral body height and stroke weight, cell-centered. Modest dark-red pixel outline for readability. No separate floating sparks, no glow haze. Each entire numeral and its tips safely inside its cell with 15 percent padding. No labels, borders, grid lines, other text or objects. Transparent alpha background, no checkerboard.
